spec: docs/IMAGES.md §4d (composer images as one state machine, the maintainer, 2026-11-11; 21:30Z attach-sheet rule)
rule: Every state x event cell gives the next state and its effects, in order. A cell left out of a platform's table is a test failure. Images leave the composer only by remove or a send; sendImages only when the model reads images.

states.attached: one or more images in the composer

events.tapPlus/sees: + on a model that reads images
events.tapPlus/blind: + on a model that can't see images
events.attachSheetChooseModel: the attach sheet's "choose an image-capable model" (shown only on a model that can't see)
events.picked: the camera or photo picker returns images (any model)
events.paste: a paste carrying an image (any model)
events.removeOne: remove x on one of several images
events.removeLast: remove x on the only image
events.modelSwitched: the model changes: a where-sheet pick, the chip, settings, a returned chat
events.tapWhereChip: the where chip, from the composer
events.alertChooseModel: the send-refused alert's "choose an image-capable model"
events.sendWithoutImages: the send-refused alert's "send text only" (shown only when there is text)
events.questionReturned: a declined still-checking question comes back with its images (any time, even under a sheet)

effects.openAttachSheet: the attach sheet opens: take photo, choose photos, the footnote
effects.openAttachSheet(cantSee): the same sheet with "<model> can't see images." and "choose an image-capable model" at its top; take photo and choose photos stay enabled
effects.closeAttachSheet: the attach sheet closes first, so the where sheet never stacks on it
effects.openWhere(readsImages): the where sheet opens at half size, tab all, reads images on (the user can turn it off); a pick returns to the composer
effects.openWhere: the where sheet opens as it does today: half size, tab all, no filter
effects.attach: the images join the composer with the arrival motion; past the limit only up to it, and the rest get the "up to {n} images per message" note (they never entered, so nothing leaves); a returned question keeps all of its images and shows the note
effects.removeAll: every image leaves the composer, as part of that send
effects.sendImages: the message goes with its images
effects.sendText: the message goes with its text only
effects.showRefusedAlert: the alert: <model> can't see images / your message wasn't sent. pick a model that can[, or send just the text]. Buttons: choose model; send text only (only when there is text); cancel
